title: The Dark Truth About X (TV series) #Shorts

Evolution does not optimize for happiness — X (TV series) shows exactly where that breaks. X, also known as X TV, is a Japanese anime television series based on the 1992 manga series by Clamp. Its twenty-four episodes were broadcast in Japan on WOWOW from October 2001 to March 2002.
